_doc: ModCar engine banks: recording plan inputs for make_banks.py. rpm in rev/min. offMode: closed = throttle shut, spark on (carburetted overrun); fuelcut = air wide open, no spark (diesel overrun). idleThrottle: speed control used for the idle take. catch: rpm the starter lets go at. ratio: rpm step ratio between neighbouring loops (each loop is played at most about +-6 % off its own pitch). offTrimDb: level correction for the overrun loops (the fuel-cut diesels pump air so freely that the simulator plays it as loud as full load; real overrun is well below it). A machine that never coasts (the generator) has offMode light: off = a light-load run with the rack (speed control) at offThrottle, at the explicit rpm steps; crankThrottle: air during the pull (1 = open, a diesel has none to shut); catchRamp: seconds of the run up from the catch to the flare; stallThrottle: rack while it is dragged down; limiterTake false: no rev-limiter take (governed); shutdownSeconds: run-down recorded after the fuel cut (any engine, default 3; a heavy flywheel runs down for longer); crankSpeed mean: the crank loop's cycle from the mean speed (a crank that swings hard), not the median; offTrimDb applies to every off loop of a light machine, its idle included, and to its catch, shutdown and stall (they start or end at its light-load run), with shotTrimDb more (the voice plays a one-shot 2 dB over the loops it hands over to). forwardGrab (any engine): the start and the restart are taken by the dyno while the starter turns the crank forwards with the spark (fuel) off, then it comes on (a high-compression single kicks back at its first firings, and a dyno that takes hold of a kick-back drives the engine backwards: nothing fires); catchRamp (any engine): seconds of the run up from the catch to the flare (default 0.22; a heavy flywheel spins up slowly). crankTrimDb: level correction for the cranking loop (a single's compressions come through the simulator far louder against its full load than a big engine's).
